subject: ACME — follow-up: pricing & invoice estimate
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia@acme.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 15:32:00 -0700
Subject: ACME — follow-up: pricing & invoice estimate

Hi Alicia / Tom — great to meet earlier. Quick recap + next steps from our discovery: 

Summary of what we discussed:
- Primary use case: in-product L2 support (multi-turn chat + short-form generation) + nightly batch embeddings for search.
- Volume profile (you shared): ~400 average prompt tokens, ~1,200 average completion tokens; expected steady-state 1.2B generated + prompt tokens / month (1.6B total tokens/month including embeddings).
- Latency SLO: <350ms p95 for user-facing chat (we discussed dedicated capacity to guarantee this).
- Critical asks: predictable unit economics, invoice estimate for budgeting, and confirmation of preferred procurement cadence (monthly vs quarterly).

Initial pricing qualification (ballpark):
- Baseline inference model: redwood-gpt-4o (quantized)
- Estimated unit cost (hosted): $15 / 1M tokens (on-demand profile)
- If committed dedicated/reserved capacity + 3M tokens/min sustained: target unit economics ~ $12 / 1M tokens (we suggested a pilot discount to validate workload).
- Example month (1.6B tokens): $19,200 @ $12/1M tokens (note: excludes data egress / addons).

Attached: ACME_Cost_Model_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet) — includes a per-path breakdown (chat vs embeddings), reserved vs hosted scenarios, and an invoice estimate tab.

Recommended next steps:
1) Can you confirm the monthly token band you expect for Q3 (range is fine)? e.g., 500M - 2B/month.
2) Confirm whether you want us to include a reserved capacity line (SLA-backed, monthly commit) in the estimate.
3) If agreeable, we’ll send a formal invoice estimate + a short contract/term sheet for procurement.

I’ll follow up with an updated invoice estimate once I have your usage band.

Thanks,
Sean
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0187
[attachment: ACME_Cost_Model_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Tom Li <tom.li@acme.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alicia Torres <alicia@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 10:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME — follow-up: pricing & invoice estimate

Sean — thanks for the clear recap. A couple quick clarifying questions: 

1) The $12 / 1M tokens number — does that assume we take reserved capacity? If so, what commitment level (tokens/month or $/mo) are you using to get to that rate?
2) How does the invoicing cadence work for pilots vs committed? We prefer monthly billing for pilots and quarterly for committed deals.
3) Any upfront onboarding / onboarding credits to note?

I've attached our internal usage projection (rough) to help you map the bands.

—Tom
Director, AI Platform | Acme Corp
[tel omitted]
[attachment: acme_usage_projection.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Li <tom.li@acme.com>, Alicia Torres <alicia@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME — follow-up: pricing & invoice estimate

Tom — great questions, quick answers + attached updated estimate: 

1) $12 / 1M tokens assumes reserved capacity (monthly commit) at the 2B token/month band. Our pricing tiers (simplified):
   - On-demand (hosted): $15 / 1M tokens
   - Reserved (monthly commit >= 1B tokens): $13 / 1M tokens
   - Reserved (monthly commit >= 2B tokens): $12 / 1M tokens + pilot discount possible

2) Invoicing cadence: pilots = monthly, reserved commitments = monthly or quarterly invoicing as you prefer (we can invoice quarterly if procurement needs that).

3) Onboarding: we typically include one complimentary week of onboarding support + a one-time engineering kickoff. No mandatory upfront platform fee for pilots; we can include modest onboarding credits in the pilot quote.

Attached: ACME_Invoice_Estimate_20270729.xlsx — contains two tabs: (1) invoice estimate (monthly cost by band), (2) cost modeling assumptions / per-token unit breakdown. Quick highlights from the estimate (rounded):
- Pilot (monthly, on-demand mix): ~1.6B tokens => ~$24,000 / month at $15/1M tokens.
- Reserved 1B commit => ~$13,000 / month.
- Reserved 2B commit => ~$24,000 / month at $12/1M tokens (lower per-unit, more predictable).
- One-time onboarding (optional) ~ $4,000 (discountable for pilots).

If you can confirm a target band (e.g., 1B-2B) I’ll run a formal term sheet and include the DocuSign + HubSpot deal link for procurement.

Link to HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/ACME-2027-02

Let me know if you’d like me to schedule a 30-minute procurement walkthrough this week.

Best,
Sean
[attachment: ACME_Invoice_Estimate_20270729.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 09:18:00 -0700

Sean / Rishi — quick internal note:
- Proposal looks reasonable based on product margin estimates.
- Recommend offering a 10% pilot discount on the reserved 2B band to accelerate proof-of-value; convert to standard reserved pricing after 3 months if usage stabilizes.
- Approve including onboarding credits up to $3,000 for the pilot.

If you want to proceed, Sean, draft the term sheet with the pilot discount and send to Tom/Alicia. I can help with urgency emails to procurement if needed.

Thanks,
Marissa
